questions.stem: Thermal conduction is the transfer of heat energy through a material by:

options.text: The movement of fluid (liquid or gas) in bulk
Particles physically moving from hot to cold regions
Vibrating particles passing energy to neighbouring particles

questions.explanation: In conduction, particles at the hotter end vibrate more vigorously and collide with neighbouring particles, transferring kinetic energy along the material. The particles themselves do not move from place to place -- only the energy is transferred.
